name: Peninsula Hot Springs Eco Lodges
signature: Fully enclosed eco lodges inside the Peninsula Hot Springs precinct — private in-room geothermal baths and the same 5am access as the glamping tents
editorNote:
The Eco Lodges are the step up from PHS Glamping when thermal access is the whole point but canvas is not. Opened 2024, ten fully enclosed structures with private in-room geothermal hot spring baths (Springs Room) or private outdoor hot springs (Peninsula Suite). Breakfast buffet and a wellness activity are included.

The bathing-precinct access and age policy (16+) are identical to the glamping tents — you get the same 5am entry and the same Hilltop Pool sequence. What changes is the format: fully weatherproof, private bathroom, no shared amenities block. The price premium over glamping is approximately $150–$450 per night, and it is paying for enclosure, privacy, and the in-room or on-deck spring.

Neither the glamping nor the eco lodge format accepts dogs or guests under 16.
whyWeGo: The enclosed version of the PHS Glamping proposition — private in-room geothermal bath, same 5am thermal precinct access.
ifOnlyOneThing: Book the Peninsula Suite for the private outdoor hot spring on the deck.
